scenes.title: From brief to MVP.

scenes.title: One bug. One mission.
scenes.subtitle: Reproduce the problem before fixing it.
scenes.prompt: Tasks disappear after reloading. Reproduce the bug, fix persistence and add a regression test.

scenes.title: Make the result verifiable.
scenes.subtitle: Useful assertions for the actions that matter.
scenes.prompt: Test task creation, filtering and persistence. Run the tests and report the command and results.

scenes.title: Find where to start.
scenes.subtitle: Map the code before changing it.
scenes.prompt: Read this repository. Find its entry points, scripts and the files to change to add a task filter.

scenes.title: Explain what you built.
scenes.subtitle: A README and a clear getting-started guide.
scenes.prompt: Write a README based on the code: setup, a usage example, known limits and a demo walkthrough.

scenes.title: Stay in touch with your agent.
scenes.subtitle: Message an already connected session.
scenes.prompt: Telegram: send a request and find the agent’s reply. Keep Crewlo open and your computer awake.

mvp_scenes.title: An idea → an MVP to verify.
mvp_scenes.subtitle: Example: TaskBoard, a local task app.
mvp_scenes.prompt: Build a React MVP with task creation, status and filtering. Local data. No accounts or payments.

mvp_scenes.title: Start with a clear mission.
mvp_scenes.subtitle: Set the scope and acceptance criteria.
mvp_scenes.prompt: First propose a plan and a file structure. List the decisions to confirm before writing code.

mvp_scenes.title: Follow the work in the studio.
mvp_scenes.subtitle: Open the agent’s conversation or terminal.
mvp_scenes.prompt: Implement the approved plan. Keep changes focused and explain the files you create.

mvp_scenes.title: An MVP needs a real test.
mvp_scenes.subtitle: Check the behavior, then inspect the evidence.
mvp_scenes.prompt: Run the build and tests. Check task creation, filtering and reloads. Report anything left untested.
